newsitem.title: GREECE: Implied drachma rates up in late trade, depos hold.
newsitem.headline: Implied drachma rates up in late trade, depos hold.

text.p: Greek depos held morning levels and implied drachma rates from forex forwards rose.
The gains in forex forwards were more pronounced in shorts but off highs in late dealings, dealers said.
The Bank of Greece did not intervene, signalling that liquidity was balancing out. Liquidity was helped by temporary cash injections from pensions, wages and Christmas bonuses.

"Depos are unmoved, but implied drachma rates maintain their firmness although they are off intraday highs," said a foreign bank dealer. "Banks position themselves for the expected auction of government securities."
Dealers said it was looking increasingly better for local banks to swap drachmas for dollars.
"You get 12.90 percent on your drachmas for something like 6.0 percent on U.S. dollars. It is not a bad deal," the dealer said.
The mark was quoted at 157.30/40 drachmas from Tuesday's 157.590 fix, the dollar at 244.08/18 drachmas from 244.930 and the Ecu at 303.89/99 from 304.050 drachmas.
"It was very quiet today with ecu/drachma edging higher as the central bank wants," a forex dealer said.
